page_title: AI Audio Isolator — Separate Voices & Sound Effects

sources.entry: Saturalabs - Uses text descriptions to separate a voice, instrument, or sound effect from audio and video, returning the target and remaining audio tracks. #paid

summary.name: Saturalabs
summary.one_liner: Saturalabs is an AI audio isolator that separates a described voice, instrument, or sound effect from an audio or video recording, returning the isolated source and the remaining background mix as WAV files.
use_cases: Separate a narrator's voice from background music
Remove music bed while keeping the scene audio
Extract a sound effect from a video for editing
Create a WAV working copy of an isolated source
Pull dialogue out of an MP4 or MOV for a video edit
summary.what_it_does: Users upload an MP3, WAV, MP4, or MOV file (up to 50 MiB) and describe one audible source, such as a voice, instrument, or sound effect. The tool returns an estimate of that source as "Isolated sound" and the rest of the mix as "Background audio". Users compare both against the original and download the chosen track as WAV. Each pass targets one described source; it does not split every instrument into separate stems. The page also lists free browser-based utilities (trimmer, joiner, fade tool) that offer WAV and MP3 export.
notable: Text-described single-source separation returning isolated source plus remaining mix
Accepts MP4 and MOV video and returns WAV audio tracks rather than a finished video
Free browser-based trimmer, joiner, and fade utilities that need no account
Ideal for keeping either the isolated source or the background track depending on the edit
caveats: Downloads require an account and sufficient credits; cost is shown on the results screen
Separation may leave bleed, change tone, or introduce artifacts, and cannot guarantee recovery of missing words or notes
Uploads limited to MP3, WAV, MP4, or MOV up to 50 MiB; larger projects must be segmented first
Overlapping sources, clipping, wind, and heavy reverb can limit results
